runs.text: The review does not report a cycle life (cycles to a fixed capacity-retention threshold) for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F. Its only quantitative statement for this material concerns energy: it relies on the Mn2+/Mn4+ redox center,

runs.quote: resulting in specific energies up to 1000 Wh kg^− 1

runs.text: . The material appears again only in the first panel of the DRX charge/discharge figure, which shows charge/discharge profiles and a capacity-versus-cycle-number inset over a short cycling window, with no retention threshold or cycle count to that threshold stated. The review's general cycle-life remarks for DRX cathodes give no figure for this compound. (

rendered: The review does not report a cycle life (cycles to a fixed capacity-retention threshold) for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F. Its only quantitative statement for this material concerns energy: it relies on the Mn2+/Mn4+ redox center, resulting in specific energies up to 1000 Wh kg^− 1[1]. The material appears again only in the first panel of the DRX charge/discharge figure, which shows charge/discharge profiles and a capacity-versus-cycle-number inset over a short cycling window, with no retention threshold or cycle count to that threshold stated. The review's general cycle-life remarks for DRX cathodes give no figure for this compound. (Fig. 9[2]).
